result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **QuickBooks Online is the best overall accounting software**\. However, depending on your business type, budget, and how you handle customers and expenses, there may be a better option.

Here are my top five recommendations for 2026.

## Best accounting software for small businesses

(Best overall)

Starting around \$38/month

- Income and expense tracking
- Bank account connections
- Invoicing and bill payments
- Profit and loss statements
- Payroll integrations and inventory options

Best if you want a comprehensive accounting system that can grow with your business.

Starting around \$27/month

- Clean, easy-to-use interface

- Bank reconciliation

- Excellent integrations

Best if multiple employees or an outside bookkeeper need access.
